subject: POC orchestration kickoff — hands-on session & capacity alignment
messages:
From: Kate Lin <kate@helixpay.com>
To: Sergio Alvarez <sergio@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
Cc: Infra Team <infra@helixpay.com>, Procurement <procurement@helixpay.com>
Date: 2026-09-01T10:05:00-07:00
Subject: POC kickoff & capacity alignment — hands-on session

Hi Sergio / Marissa,

Thanks again for the demo last week — the team at HelixPay is keen to move to a two-week hands-on POC so we can validate routing and cost under our peak patterns. We have three priorities for the kickoff session:

- Walk through prompt sets and prompt templates (ML ops team will bring edge cases).
- Validate routing behavior for fraud-detection requests (mixed short/long sequences).
- Run a focused load test to confirm token budgets and SLOs (peak concurrency ~40 rps).

We are flexible on whether this is Hosted trial capacity or a short Dedicated reservation; procurement will want a recommendation from you on quota bumps and expected token spend before they approve the short-term commit.

Can we do a hands-on session next week? Our tentative windows: Thu 9/2 10–12 PT or Fri 9/3 13–15 PT. If you can propose a 90-minute agenda and what we should have pre-provisioned (quota, test creds, sample prompts), that would help accelerate procurement.

Also looping in Infra (copied) — they will want the rate-limit and network egress guidance.

Thanks,
Kate
Kate Lin
Head of ML Platforms, HelixPay

From: Sergio Alvarez <sergio@redwood.com>
To: Kate Lin <kate@helixpay.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>, Dylan Brooks <dylan@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-09-01T11:20:00-07:00
Subject: Re: POC kickoff & capacity alignment — hands-on session

Hi Kate — thanks, excited to run this. Thu 9/2 10–11:30 PT works for our team; if you need the 90-minute window we can extend to 11:30. Proposed quick agenda below:

1) 10:00–10:15 — Goals & success criteria (you)
2) 10:15–10:35 — Prompt review & templating (Marissa)
3) 10:35–11:00 — Routing config walkthrough (Dylan)
4) 11:00–11:25 — Controlled load test (we'll run a 15-min ramp + 10-min steady)
5) 11:25–11:30 — Next steps / procurement handoff

Pre-reqs we need from HelixPay:
- A small sample set of production prompts (anonymized) and expected token/response length distributions.
- Decision on trial mode: Hosted burst quota (fastest) or Dedicated 1-week reservation (predictable latency). We can recommend one after we see the prompt mix, but rough guidance below:
  * Hosted trial: minimal lead time, recommended if you want no infra onboarding and are tolerant of occasional model fallback behavior. Needs a temporary quota bump to ~1.2M tokens/day for the load test.
  * Short Dedicated reservation: 1–2 business days lead time for GPU allocation; recommended if you need strict latency SLO and predictable egress. Estimated commitment: 300 GPU-hours (for two days of load tests + warmup) — we’ll send a formal estimate.

Attachments: I’ve attached a short capacity estimate and a runbook skeleton. Marissa will fill in routing test steps.

If Thu 9/2 10:00 PT is confirmed I’ll send a calendar invite with a Zoom link and test credentials.

—
Sergio Alvarez
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
sergio@redwood.com

From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
To: Kate Lin <kate@helixpay.com>, Sergio Alvarez <sergio@redwood.com>
Cc: Dylan Brooks <dylan@redwood.com>, Mina Haddad <mina@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-09-02T09:15:00-07:00
Subject: Re: POC kickoff & capacity alignment — hands-on session

Kate — adding technical details and what we'll run during the hands-on:

Quick notes:
- Prompt review: please upload a zipped set (<=10 examples per template) to the shared Drive link before EOD 9/1. We will run token profiling to confirm the median and 95th percentile lengths.
- Routing: we will demo two policies — latency-priority (short queries to a smaller model) and cost-priority (longer sequences to a quantized variant). We need to know which policy you want as default for the POC.
- Load tests: plan is a 15-minute ramp to target concurrency and a 20-minute soak. We will generate synthetic traffic that mirrors your ratio of streaming vs batch requests. Expected peak token burn: ~1.1–1.4M tokens/hour depending on model choice.

Checklist for you (Procurement/Infra):
- Temporary quota bump to 1.5M tokens/day for 3 days (scope: test account only).
- If Dedicated: approval for 300 GPU-hours and a short SLA addendum.
- Network: list of egress IPs needed for firewall rules (we'll provide).

Attachments included:
- poc_capacity_estimate.xlsx (spreadsheet) — rough token & cost scenarios
- demo_runbook.md (text) — session steps and who owns each task
- routing_test_plan.pdf (pdf) — test cases for routing and expected outputs

If Thu 9/2 10:00 PT is still preferred, I will send the detailed runbook and test payloads by 17:00 PT today.

—
Marissa Cole
Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
marissa@redwood.com

From: Kate Lin <kate@helixpay.com>
To: Sergio Alvarez <sergio@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
Cc: Infra Team <infra@helixpay.com>, Procurement <procurement@helixpay.com>
Date: 2026-09-03T16:22:00-07:00
Subject: Re: POC kickoff & capacity alignment — hands-on session

Thanks — 9/2 10:00 PT works for us. Confirming:

- Agenda approved as proposed.
- Procurement will pre-approve a temporary quota bump (1.5M tokens/day) for the test account; they asked for a cost estimate which Marissa already attached (thanks).
- Infra will whitelist Redwood egress IPs once you provide the list.
- We'll default routing to latency-priority for the POC; if we see false positives we will switch to cost-priority for background batch jobs.

Two small asks before kickoff: 
1) Can you provide the test credentials and sample curl examples in the calendar invite?
2) Please mark the runbook with explicit rollback steps in case we hit a noisy-burst scenario during the soak.

Forwarding to Infra & Procurement for awareness. See you Thu.

Best,
Kate
Kate Lin
Head of ML Platforms, HelixPay
